# UZAS Sports

> UZAS Sports is a custom sportswear and sports equipment manufacturer, established in 2005, with its own factory in Sialkot, Pakistan, and showrooms in Sialkot and Melbourne, Australia. We specialise in custom sublimated team kits and also make martial arts uniforms, performance apparel, paintball gear, gloves and custom patches. Every order is designed, printed, cut, stitched and checked in our own factory.

## Key facts
- Established: 2005
- Factory: Sialkot, Punjab, Pakistan
- Showrooms: Sialkot, Pakistan and Hadfield, Melbourne VIC, Australia
- Minimum order: none. Orders start from a single piece.
- Samples: free customised samples
- Shipping: worldwide by air freight and sea freight; free shipping on orders of 25 pieces or more
- Design: free design support, from an idea or logo to a print-ready design
- Order types: custom team orders, wholesale and private label

## What we make
- Sublimated clothing: team jerseys, singlets, rash guards, compression tops, cycling kits and warm-up jackets. https://www.uzassports.com/sublimation-clothing
- Martial arts and combat sports: BJJ gis, karate and taekwondo uniforms, fight shorts, rash guards and belts. https://www.uzassports.com/martial-arts-combat-sports
- Apparel: training tees, hoodies, joggers, tracksuits, shorts and polos. https://www.uzassports.com/apparel
- Paintball: jerseys, pants, gloves and pod harnesses. https://www.uzassports.com/paintball
- Gloves: boxing, MMA, bag, tactical, work and cycling gloves. https://www.uzassports.com/gloves
- Custom patches: embroidered, woven, PVC, leather and chenille. https://www.uzassports.com/custom-patches

## Who we work with
Gyms, martial arts academies, sports clubs, schools, teams and apparel brands in Australia, the USA and worldwide.
